title: Validate reflective class lookup across the released Codec pair
description: Compare ordered original Plexus and Codec releases on the ordinary strict checker after binding reflective cache dependencies. Verify preserved names and the changed Codec superclass, then require a JVM-reproduced witness for lookup of the incremental x86 class introduced in Codec 1.14. Run every Boolean caller cold and warm and preserve the earlier six measurements.
expected: Eight native verdicts agree with every original Boolean outcome, and every reported changed input reproduces with exact before and after strings.

resources.notes: The first six comparisons in job 20261124-110402-verify-original-class-names-on-plexus-an took 2.2 seconds of measured execution.
